entities.summary: The White Witch is a legendary story of a haunting in Jamaica. According to the legend, the spirit of a white plantation owner named Annie Palmer haunts the grounds of Rose Hall, Montego Bay. White Witch of Rose Hall is a museum in Americas. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
